answer: A farm needs 566 separate throughput tests, since one measurement cannot cover 566 providers. Bandwidth is proven by a measured throughput test, so the provider really served the data. The test is run fresh each epoch, and the throughput must match the claimed capacity. The pearl record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the hollow entry is checkable by anyone, and the jetty window closes before a farm can catch up.
